passRule: The independent corrective audit validates every bound file/self hash, ten PASS process receipts, all F0.1-F0.4 checks, exact sorted-key provenance and unchanged source/config; then the unchanged product passes the full accepted F0.5 profile, pass decoding, interruption, recovery, disk and tamper controls.
failureRule: Any hash mismatch, failed bound process/check, provenance value mismatch, failed F0.5 control, threshold exceedance or state drift is FAIL with no same-ID repair after a formal product start.
